The best and trustworthy dental clinic in town. The dentist is professional and patiently explaining all the treatments and questions i had (perfectly in English) 👍. The prevention program she provided is very effective and critical. A process teaching us how to treat our teeth health better.

Environment is good as well. Newly opened. Parking is convenient as well. I parked at the soi. But opposite side 7-11 also have quite some parking.

Highly recommended.

This dental clinic provides comprehensive care, starting with preventative care and advice before problems arise. The atmosphere is lovely, making it ideal for both children and adults who want to take care of their oral health and prevent oral diseases.

This is a clinic for children and families. The signage inside the clinic is very cute, showing that the doctor truly cares for everyone. They have prevention programs for both children and adults. Anyone who wants to focus on preventing oral health should come to this clinic.
The clinic emphasizes prevention, not just treatment. This was my child's first dental check-up at 1 year and 5 months old. The place is lovely and child-friendly. All the staff are wonderful.

I wanted to write this review because I'm truly impressed. The dentist here is the kindest in the world, in my opinion. My biggest worry when taking children to the dentist is that they'll be scared, cry, or refuse to go through the procedure. But this clinic completely dispelled all my worries.

The dentist is excellent at communicating with children, very patient, and interacts with them naturally. This made the children feel trusting. What I thought would be a scary dental procedure turned into a comfortable, non-crying, and non-resistent experience for the children.

The equipment and tools were modern, clean, and made me feel confident that my children were being well cared for.

Another lovely thing that impressed me personally is that the dentist refers to herself as "Doctor Need," but I always heard "Mommy." It felt so warm and comforting, like having a kind person caring for them and making the children feel safe naturally. Even I, as a mother, felt relieved.

Thank you for making dental visits for my children a non-scary and wonderful experience. ❤️

I'm so glad I found this dental clinic. My child loves it! The dentist is very kind, lovely, and highly skilled. She explains things well and clearly, and truly understands children. The price is also good. ^^
